obsidian.$description: Obsidian — Neutral form states, badge text, and quiet UI feedback where color should stay understated. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

paper-white.$description: Paper White — Page canvas, card surfaces, filled-button text — the bright stage everything sits on

deep-ink.$description: Deep Ink — Secondary text and input field treatment — a near-black that softens long-form body copy without losing contrast

graphite.$description: Graphite — Muted helper text and secondary descriptions — a mid-gray that recedes behind Obsidian labels

warm-stone.$description: Warm Stone — Tertiary text, subdued link and border accents — a desaturated taupe that warms the otherwise cold grayscale

ember-tag.$description: Ember Tag — Product-UI accent visible in feature mockups (agent tags, handoff markers) — the only chromatic punctuation, kept small and functional

geigy-ll-duplex-var.$description: Display and editorial headings — a custom neo-grotesque variable face that sets the entire tone; aggressive negative tracking at 48–113px pulls letters tight for a compressed, architectural headline

inter.$description: UI, body copy, form fields, button labels — the workhorse at 14–16px, with 10px reserved for uppercase eyebrow labels at expanded tracking

system-sans-serif.$description: Fallback and small utility rendering at 12px — appears in decorative or rendering contexts where Inter is not loaded
